title: Chapter 2789 - 116: Kneel Down_2
content:
Chapter 2789: Chapter 116: Kneel Down_2

Why is this happening?

Sishen is clearly truly "dead". There’s not a single trace of vitality on him now, nor any form of "drive".

Yet he just crawled out from underground to continue "devouring" people.

"What on earth is happening..."

Lugu frowned deeply, his expression exceedingly grave.

The others were equally shocked and fearful, their faces filled with terror.

But soon, they didn’t have time to think further.

Sishen, with a severed arm, stood silently in place, truly like a dead object, without even a trace of presence around him, even his Divine Sense hardly detectable.

Yet his flesh kept writhing.

The arm cut off by Lugu, seemed to have life itself, writhing on its own, crawled onto Sishen’s severed limb, as flesh buds wriggled and fused together.

Clearly dead, but appears alive.

And living in a bizarre manner.

In the next moment, Sishen’s eye sockets suddenly sunk inward, turning an even darker shade.

The hearts of the people skipped a beat.

Chi Feng immediately said: "Be careful, it’s going to eat people!"

Before the words finished, Sishen’s figure disappeared again, reappearing in front of Chi Feng.

Chi Feng was shocked, hurriedly brandished his spear to obstruct.

But he didn’t even manage to see clearly Sishen’s movement, then felt a sharp pain in his tiger’s mouth, the long spear knocked askew.

Under an immense, Non-Human-like Strength, Chi Feng’s legs leaned on the ground, sliding backward more than ten steps, spitting blood.

Before finishing spitting the blood, a foul stench wafted his nose.

Chi Feng looked up and saw an ugly face, hollow eye sockets looking at him.

At the same time, a pair of bloody large hands descended towards his skull, seeming to want to directly crack it open.

Chi Feng’s old strength was exhausted, new strength not yet born, unable to resist, his face turning pale.

Dan Zhu urgently, hurriedly activated a Mystic Fire Feather, striking at Sishen, but he only had Initial Golden Core strength, the power of this Mystic Fire was barely sufficient to block Sishen.

Just at this moment, a Demon Bone Cutting Knife broke through the air, directly severing Sishen’s arm, saving Chi Feng.

Sishen was angered again after his arm was severed, letting out a low growl.

Though the sound was low, not sharp, it stirred agitation and fear from the depths of one’s heart.

For a moment, everyone was intimidated, their Heart Spirit turbulent.

Taking advantage of this gap, the arm fallen to the ground, blood buds writhing, began to fuse back towards Sishen.

Chi Feng seized the opportunity, suppressing the agitation and fear in his heart, immediately brandished the spear, to pierce through Sishen’s arm, pinning it to the ground, preventing further fusion.

This spear indeed pierced Sishen’s severed arm.

Also, effectively pinned Sishen’s broken arm to the ground.

Yet, in the next moment, Sishen’s severed arm started to directly rot into amorphous flesh, bypassing Chi Feng’s spear, merging back into Sishen’s body.

Sishen’s arm grew out once more.

Seeing this, everyone grew solemn.

Lugu took a deep breath, saying: "Everyone, full force... kill Sishen."

He was completely resigned.

His brother was indeed dead, what remained now was just an indescribable fleshy monster.

The siege against Sishen restarted.

The Golden Core level siege was extremely stunning.

And soon, not only Sishen, those already buried, remnants of the Sibone Tribe, even "came" back alive, emerging one after another from the underground, aiming to devour people.

Danque Tribe’s Barbarian Soldiers and those Sibone remnants clashed again.

The chaos appeared to repeat again.

Only, the previous Sibone Tribe members, still had a trace of Life Force after all.

Now, they were completely dead, reanimated beyond logic, completely devoid of Life Force as "walking flesh".

Moreover, these "walking flesh" were even harder to deal with.

For those with Life Force, if the Heart Meridian was severed, limbs broken, and flesh lacked "drive" supply, Life Force completely extinguished, they were effectively "killed".

But these "dead people" in sight, even when killed, limbs severed, they still could fuse blood and flesh, crawling back up.

Before the mass of Bone and six thousand Barbarian Soldiers, the number of those Sibone remnants wasn’t an advantage, though tricky, but not impossible to suppress.

Just keep killing.

Once alive, kill them, over and over again.

Mo Hua’s barbarian soldiers possessed this strength.

The truly tricky issue was the Late Golden Core Stage General Sishen.

The previous Sishen was already very strong.

But now, having died once, fearless of dying again, flesh still able to fuse and regenerate, this "Sishen" almost stood invincible, terrifying in essence.

A group of Golden Core Cultivators joined forces, engaging in a bitter struggle against Sishen.

Following the tactics previously stated by Mo Hua, they performed "wheel slaughter".

Lugu genuinely harbored killing intent towards his "brother", not holding back anymore.

Yet no matter how they slaughtered, they could not truly "kill" Sishen.

The surroundings of Sishen were cut off, only to fuse again.

The chest penetrated, but the blood and flesh would meld again.

Even once, the head was severed, but the headless Sishen still battled fiercely.

Like a figure, an "undying, indestructible" terrifying warlock.

Very soon, Sishen reconnected his head.

Despair began to sprout among the Golden Core Barbarian Cultivators.

They truly didn’t know how to "kill" Sishen, didn’t understand why the dead Sishen remained unkillable, no matter how much they tried.

Once despair set in, the heart would have a flaw.

Among the Shugu Monsters, the fourth among them, had dread seize his heart. He dared not confront an eternally unkillable "monster".
